title: The Chopper Goes Down and Lacy Still Has Time to Argue
caption: The chopper is going down and Lacy still has time to take an insult personally. #LACY #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: I'd be too busy watching the chopper to even hear the insult.

title: Lacy Yells “I'm Gonna Eat You” Mid-Getaway
caption: Lacy actually says “I'm gonna eat you” mid-getaway. Wait until that confidence turns into panic. #LACY #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: I'd forget the whole chase if my teammate yelled that.
why: The bizarre opening threat is instantly quotable, and the later SWAT panic flips Lacy's confidence.
